summary: OAuth2ConnectionMixin provides reusable connect/refresh lifecycle for OAuth2 providers. Handles token loading from store, migration from profile.auth fields, token refresh with file locking, and auto-authorization. Exposes .client property for the underlying httpx.Client.

key_classes.name: OAuth2ConnectionMixin
key_classes.summary: Mixin class. Subclasses must set _spec (with .name and .metadata) and _base_url class variables. connect() returns Self with _client set to an authenticated httpx.Client. Supports context manager protocol.

key_functions.name: OAuth2ConnectionMixin.connect
key_functions.summary: Main entry point. Loads tokens from store, migrates from profile.auth if needed, refreshes expired tokens with file lock, or triggers auto_authorize. Returns Self.

key_functions.name: OAuth2ConnectionMixin.client
key_functions.summary: Property exposing the underlying httpx.Client (or None before connect).

extension_points: Subclass and set _spec + _base_url to create a provider-specific connection class
Override _client usage patterns in subclass methods
lifecycle_notes: Token migration path: if store has no token but profile.auth has access_token, saves it to store
Refresh uses file locking (store.lock) to prevent concurrent refresh races
On refresh failure: clears stored tokens and raises AuthorizationRequired (unless auto_authorize)
documentation_hooks: Token lifecycle state machine: load -> check expiry -> refresh -> re-authorize
How to subclass for a new provider
Migration behavior from inline profile credentials to store
risks: Refresh failure clears tokens — if auto_authorize is False, user must re-authorize

evidence.detail: OAuth2ConnectionMixin class with connect(), client property, context manager
Tests for no-token, valid-token, expired-token, client property scenarios
